# Abdul Mueed

> Abdul Mueed is a software architect and full-stack engineer with nearly a decade of experience building scalable systems and SaaS products end to end — from system architecture to delivery, plus the DevOps and infrastructure behind them. He also teaches beginners to become job-ready full-stack developers.

Primary skills: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, product design, AI/LLM integration, DevOps.

Companies he has worked with: Boost Lifestyle (boost-lifestyle.co), DigitEMB (digitemb.com), Tahseen Islam (tahseenislam.com), LawShaoor (lawshaoor.com).

## Products

- [Krest](https://portfolio.mueed.xyz/project/krest): AI email & messaging platform for embroidery digitizing studios. Used by DigitEMB.
- [Krispin](https://portfolio.mueed.xyz/project/krispin): AI WhatsApp agent for online stores. Used by Boost Lifestyle.
- [Etcher](https://portfolio.mueed.xyz/project/etcher): HR & project management software for small startups. Used by ExtensorLabs.
- [Classman](https://portfolio.mueed.xyz/project/classman): Class & batch scheduling for educators.
- [Vance](https://portfolio.mueed.xyz/project/vance): Project & task management platform for freelancers.
- [Parhle](https://portfolio.mueed.xyz/project/parhle): Free notes & resources sharing platform for university students.
- [Brenks](https://portfolio.mueed.xyz/project/brenks): AI-assisted workflow orchestration platform for SMEs.
